themes.description: 7 champion buffs, 4 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: "Enlightenment can only be achieved once you free yourself of anger, and regret." Structured changes across 18 entities this patch.

champions.name: Briar
champions.tldr: New Effect: All attacks during her Blood Frenzy now have an uncancellable windup.; Recast time changed to 0.15 seconds from 100% of her attack windup.
champions.gameplayImpact: Briar is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: All attacks during her Blood Frenzy now have an uncancellable windup.

lines.label: Recast time

systems.name: ARAM
systems.tldr: ARAM maps will now randomly rotate between Butcher's Bridge, Howling Abyss, and the new Koeshin's Crossing map each game from 25.13 until 25.16.; Removed: Rerolling champions has been removed.
systems.gameplayImpact: ARAM loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: ARAM maps will now randomly rotate between Butcher's Bridge, Howling Abyss, and the new Koeshin's Crossing map each game from 25.13 until 25.16.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Rerolling champions has been removed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New: In the first 15 seconds of Champion Select, players will be presented two champion cards to choose from, with approximately a 5–30% (over 0–100) chance[https://www.reddit.com/r/ARAM/comments/1l7iiy1/the_new_card_system_is_a_massive_buff_for_aram/mx22fcl/?context=3 Cadmus on Third Champion Card Chances] of being offered three instead.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players still roll a random champion out of the player's available champions (owned champions + free rotation).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Each player's unselected champions will then be added to the bench.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players can swap to their own offerings freely during this time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The 70-second consolidated selection phase has been replaced with a 45-second finalization phase after the champion reveal phase.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: All champions in the bench incur a 3-second cooldown upon the finalization phase ensuing and upon swapping to any champion.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Return of the -themed ARAM map.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The non-base portions of the lane have a variable width. The far wall at the non-base portions of the lane and excluding the middle features a slight, arched recess.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Frost-gates are replaced by Cannon Launchers, one next to each team's fountain.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players can issue a Move/Attack order (default: MB2/right-click) while near a Cannon Launcher to enter it, becoming vanish for up to 10 seconds, after which they are forced out. They can then Select (default: MB1/left-click) a location to dash themselves up to 6500 units away while being displacement immune, reduced to 4500 after their team's Outer turret has been destroyed. Upon landing, they become lockout for 0.5 seconds, and cause an impact that deals 120–460 magic damage to nearby enemies and airborne for 0.75 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Health relics cannot be picked up while in flight and for 2 seconds after landing.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: An alcove has been added at the map's close boundary in the middle of the lane which features a 20px|link= Power Flower plant with 3 hit points. It first spawns at 0:40 and has a respawn timer of 60 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Each hit against the plant refunds 8% of the attacker's abilities' total cooldown and grants a shield equal to 8% of their maximum health that decays over 8 seconds. The shield can stack and refresh with subsequent hits.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New -themed ARAM map. The blue (Order) team represents the Kinkou Shrine, while the red (Chaos) team represents the Twilight Temple.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The non-base portions of the lane have a variable width. The middle is similar to Howling Abyss', but the other parts are narrower.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Frost-gates are replaced by Bloom Portals.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bloom Portals function the same as the Frost-gates on the Howling Abyss, but they grant nearby champions moving towards them 50% bonus movement speed decaying over 1 second and can be initiated by moving on top of them rather than using a Move order (default: MB2/right-click) on them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The bump at the far boundary in the middle of the lane which featured two large patches of brush is replaced by a small lair which is separated from the main lane by a thin Deep Water wall, running lengthways to the lane.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Two patches of brush exist beyond the long ends of this wall, one on each side, which curve outward to connect with the map's far boundary.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Deep Water: Behaves like terrain for pathing purposes, but has river properties and does not block sight.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: A pair of additional Bloom Portals exists at each side of the map at the middle of the lane: one is on the far wall of the lair at the map's far boundary, while the other is straight across the lane at the map's close boundary.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Two additional small patches of brush have been added, one on each side of the latter portal at a small distance.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: A long brush has also been added at the corner of each base on the map's close wall, between the inhibitor and its turret.

lines.after: have a pink and blue tint
lines.note: The Death Screen has been changed to have a pink and blue tint from the default grey tint, and now plays a background ambience noise.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The look of is changed to match the map's theme. They may also carry spirit blossoms and fruits on their head.
